data.narrative:
Isomorphic Labs, a Series B biotech company founded by Demis Hassabis, is evaluated against a comparable universe of 3 public and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector. The company has raised $2.7B to date.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $2.7B total raised proxy, implying $5.1B. Peer-median analysis benchmarks against three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies (Colossal Biosciences at $10.3B, Chai Discovery at $3.8B, and New Limit at $3.1B), yielding a median of $3.8B with a range of $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples is not applicable, as the target's revenue is not disclosed. The three public biotech comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) show a median P/S of 7.4x, but cannot be applied without revenue data.

Triangulating these two applicable methods produces a valuation range of $3.2B (low) to $5.9B (high), with a median of $4.5B. The 82% spread between low and high reflects material divergence between peer-median and stage-progression approaches, driven primarily by outlier valuation of Colossal Biosciences. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the peer set for a founder-led frontier AI/biotech firm and the forward-looking revenue trajectory that would anchor a public-comp multiple.
